items.overview: When pop group Connect 3 returns to Camp Rock to search for an opening act for their reunion tour, rising tensions and fierce competition among campers test old friendships and spark unexpected romances.
When an unexpected road rage incident puts his son in critical condition, an enraged father spirals down a dark path of emotional turmoil and vengeance.

items.title: The Muppet Show
items.overview: Music, comedy, and a whole lot of chaos is bound to ensue when The Muppets once again take the stage of the original Muppet Theatre with their very special guest, Sabrina Carpenter!

items.title: The Dating App Killer: The Monica White Story
items.overview: A divorcee reenters the dating pool by creating an online profile, but when her match displays unsettling behavior and a series of women from the same dating site go missing, she must save herself from becoming the next victim.

items.title: A Knight to Remember
items.overview: A statue of an English knight arrives in Chicago for an art exhibit. While cleaning the statue, museum conservator Emily impulsively kisses the statue, bringing him to life.

items.title: A Second Chance Christmas
items.overview: Anna and James Campbell have been divorced for five years, their once-happy union now a carefully managed truce for the sake of their children. When their daughter invites the entire family to meet her serious boyfriend over Christmas at her grandparents’ rustic Smoky Mountain cabin, the former couple reluctantly agrees. Arriving a day early to avoid awkwardness, Anna is surprised to find James has the same idea. But when the worst ice storm in a decade traps them in the mountains with no way out, the exes are forced to confront the history they share – and the possibility that their story may not be finished after all.

items.title: Angel in the Rubble: The Genelle Guzman Story
items.overview: A Lifetime original recounting the true story of Genelle Guzman, the last survivor pulled alive from the World Trade Center ruins after 27 hours. The biographical drama chronicles her harrowing experience during the September 11 attacks and premieres on September 12, 2026, to mark the 25th anniversary of 9/11.

items.title: The Spirit of Halloween
items.overview: Brilliant bridal designer Everly Stone has no patience for Halloween, especially the beloved fire-station bash that once left her heartbroken in front of everyone she knew, but when her late mentor appears with a glamorous warning, Everly Stone is swept through one unforgettable night by three mischievous spirits who reveal the joy she lost, the people she’s pushing away, and the future she might miss if she keeps hiding behind work and fear. With a loyal assistant ready for more, a town waiting to welcome her back, and longtime friend Beau Madison still carrying a spark from their past, Everly Stone must decide whether Halloween is the night that broke her heart or the one that can finally help it heal.

items.title: Kentucky Roses
items.overview: Kentucky Roses follows Sadie, a Churchill Downs greenhouse worker dreaming of designing the iconic Kentucky Derby rose garland, and Ash, the son of the track's CEO who is trying to hide his identity to prove his own worth.** When a storm damages the venue two weeks before the big race, the pair must team up to repair the iconic Twin Spires and save the traditional rose blanket. Along the way, they discover a 1932 connection between their families whose romance was torn apart by class differences, forcing them to navigate past history to find their own future together.

items.title: Lost in Paradise
items.overview: When the founder of a high-end fashion company gets marooned on a "deserted" island with a chef, romance blossoms as they work together to survive.

items.title: Falling into Place
items.overview: Kaia returns home for her town's fall festival as well as her high school reunion and spends the week with her childhood best friend, James, to complete their unfinished fall bucket list.

items.title: A Machu Picchu Proposal
items.overview: Katie agrees to join her brother Dan and his girlfriend Luciana on a trip to Peru. Dan plans to propose to Luciana in a grand way at Machu Picchu at the end of the week and needs Katie’s Spanish speaking skills to ask Luciana’s Peruvian father for his blessing. However, when Luciana’s friend, Chef Carlos, arrives, he accidentally ruins each proposal attempt. Refusing to give up, Katie does everything in her power to make this proposal happen, until Dan calls it off. Katie must lean into Chef Carlos’ spontaneity to not only save the day and the proposal, and Carlos may just win Katie’s heart too!

items.title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
items.overview: Sarah is drawn into a dangerous relationship with a middle-aged surgeon Dr. James Ryan. As Dr. Ryan secretly supplies her with surgical-grade drugs to keep her compliant and submissive, Sarah's life spirals out of control.

items.title: Best Served Cold: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
items.overview: When a suspect in a forgery case is murdered and the prosecutor goes missing, Hannah and Chad must uncover how the two cases are connected and solve them in time for the trial.

items.title: The Night Everything Changed
items.overview: When Tina's teenage daughter doesn't return home from a sleepover with her closest friends, she goes on a frantic hunt to find her before it's too late. In the process, she unravels dark secrets of a forbidden romance and a tryst among BFFs.

items.title: The Pastor Who Preys
items.overview: Budding fashion designer, Nicole, relocates to a small lake-side town for the summer to work on her first collection and spend time with her cousin, Amanda. When Amanda turns up dead in mysterious accident, Nicole begins to suspect that something is off.

items.title: Chernobyl: 48 Hours To Escape
items.overview: Witnesses, survivors and front-line heroes recall the first days of the Chernobyl disaster of April 1986. Featuring rare archive footage of the world's worst ever nuclear accident.

items.title: Cop This
items.overview: It's Grand Final Day and in a suburban police station about to be replaced by an AI 'Terminal', the two remaining cops (Nicolette Minster and Ray O'Leary) are tasked with babysitting a drug dealer for 24 hours.

items.title: Stamptown
items.overview: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

items.title: No One Leaves
items.overview: When Meredith and her husband go to have dinner with their neighbor on the next farm over, he introduces them to his visiting niece. But as the evening progresses, Meredith begins to suspect that this young woman isn't his niece, but his captive.

items.title: A Very Arctic Christmas
items.overview: Single dad Jim and his spirited, science-minded 20-year-old daughter, Isla, share a tradition of alternating who decides how they spend Christmas each year. Jim, a former major league baseball player turned broadcaster, never misses hosting his annual Christmas Eve show from Times Square – until Isla persuades him to take a once-in-a-lifetime Arctic cruise, promising they will return in time for his broadcast.

items.title: The Secret Lives of Suburban Housewives
items.overview: When one couple moves to suburbia, they realize their neighbors are hiding more than a few scandals. After a shocking death rattles the neighborhood, lies and revelations come to surface as a killer races against time to keep their secret buried for good.

items.title: Vanished in an Instant
items.overview: After her daughter disappears from a gas station, a mother's race against time uncovers a chilling truth buried beneath a quiet town's surface.

items.title: The Way to You
items.overview: New Yorkers Emma and Conrad agree to help each other find their missed connections after a subway blackout. Their search might lead to love, but not where either of them expects to find it.

items.title: The Babysitter’s Double Life
items.overview: A College Student begins an affair with a wealthy man who inspires her to create a babysitting-adjacent service for lonely, divorced fathers. However, things soon get dangerous as the operation grows into a full prostitution ring under her name.

items.title: I Killed Him in My Sleep
items.overview: Millennial Kelty Crawford struggles with financial strain, career uncertainty, and a wedding she can't afford. Desperate for money, Crawford enrolls in a sleep-study experiment that spirals into terror when she experiences a vivid, violent dream of a dying man, a bloody knife in her hand, and a voice accusing her of murder.

items.title: Christmas by the Spoonful
items.overview: When a food critic with no culinary abilities of her own is tasked with preparing her family's first Christmas dinner since the passing of their beloved matriarch, she is forced to enlist the help of a local French food truck owner whom she nearly put out of business with a bad review.

items.title: A Season to Blossom
items.overview: An aspiring writer takes over her late grandmother's bookstore and finds love.

items.title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
items.overview: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.

items.title: The Man in the Window
items.overview: A grieving widow grows suspicious of her mysterious new neighbor after local crimes occur. Despite her friend's support, the community dismisses her concerns, leaving her to uncover the unsettling truth alone.

items.title: Double Double Trouble
items.overview: Reeling from a devastating miscarriage and the collapse of her marriage, Drea struggles to rebuild her life when her identical twin sister Ali finds love with Ryan, a man who represents everything Drea believes she's lost.

items.title: Much About Love
items.overview: A TV director returns to her theater roots for a Shakespeare festival and runs into an old flame, rekindling a merry war of wits in this modern retelling of "Much Ado About Nothing."

items.title: Pumpkin Regatta Romance
items.overview: When their fathers refuse to move past a disagreement, Nadine, daughter of the boat shop owner, and Ethan, a pumpkin farmer, team up to heal the feud and revive the town's Pumpkin Regatta.

items.title: Missing the Boat
items.overview: Strangers Kelly and Parker both end up on the same Italian cruise, but after missing the boat during a stop, they're forced to team up and race across southern Italy to catch up.

items.title: A Christmas Cookie Caper: A Puzzle Time Mystery
items.overview: When a celebrity baker is found unconscious during Winter Haven's 100th Annual Christmas Cookie Challenge, amateur sleuth Vera Vexley races to clear her friend's name. With stolen recipes, hidden secrets and a cryptic crossword clue leading the way, Vera must solve the mystery before Christmas.

items.title: Mary J. Blige Presents Be Happy
items.overview: Mary J. Blige Presents Be Happy follows 50-year-old Val (Tisha Campbell), a devoted wife and stay at home mom, who is eager to reignite the spark in her marriage when her youngest child leaves for college. Grappling with empty-nest feelings, loneliness and growing emotional distance from her husband Ross (Russell Hornsby), Val begins to realize that her marriage and the woman she once was, may be slipping away. A spontaneous escape to New Orleans to support her pregnant daughter, Kayla (Zing Ashford), awakens long-buried dreams and passions and introduces her to Peter Mosley (Mekhi Phifer), a handsome and charismatic photographer who sees her in ways she has forgotten to see herself. Reawakening her artistic spirit and rediscovering her worth, Val must face a life-altering question: is it ever too late to choose yourself and the love you truly deserve?

items.title: The Boy with My Son's Face
items.overview: Susan's baby dies, and she is convicted for a crime she doesn’t even remember committing. Years later, out on parole and fighting to start over, Susan sees a photograph that stops her cold.

items.title: Nikki Glaser: Good Girl
items.overview: Considered one of the most fearless voices in modern comedy, Nikki Glaser delivers a brutally honest special that takes on aging, beauty, and fame - confronting what it means to stay relevant, desirable, and real in a culture that never looks away.

items.title: The Seemingly Perfect Family
items.overview: Inspired by true events. When 18-year-old Lexi ages out of the foster care system and lies to get an au pair job, the dream family she is working for turns out to be a nightmare as she uncovers their twisted secrets. Rylee Reagan stars.

items.title: A Match Made in Melbourne
items.overview: Georgie, a travel writer, travels to Melbourne for an assignment where she meets Zach, an ex-Australian footballer who agrees to be her tour guide and shows her that there's more to life than work.

items.title: O Little Christmas Market
items.overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

items.title: A Royal Setting
items.overview: Ruby, a world-renowned gemologist, is hired by Prince Luca to restore the crown jewels and design his crown, challenging tradition and complicating his relationship with his mother, the queen.

items.title: Love, Again
items.overview: Caroline and Henry's 30-year marriage faces upheaval when he's diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's. As Henry's memory deteriorates, Caroline finds comfort in friendship with Leo while coping with losing her partner.

items.title: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
items.overview: Making his Broadway debut, legendary comic Jeff Ross turns the spotlight on himself in a one-man show that is as heartfelt as it is hilarious.
companies: Enough with the Bread Already Productions

items.title: Toast to Italy
items.overview: Jenny travels to Italy for a special bottle of wine for her sister's wedding. She meets Arrigo, also looking for the famous "Love Wine" and together their search leads to a love of their own.

items.title: To Catch a Cheater
items.overview: When her teenage daughter dies under mysterious circumstances, a mother's search for truth unravels a chain of lies and betrayal among her closest friends, forcing her to confront evil in her own circle.

items.title: The Caretaker
items.overview: After a car accident leaves Miles paralyzed, his wife hires a live-in caretaker who will stop at nothing to become the man of the house.

items.title: Killer Clown
items.overview: Decades after witnessing her mother’s brutal murder at the hands of the “Killer Clown,” Elizabeth Helmer (Sara Paxton) remains haunted by the crime that shattered her childhood. When she begins investigating the long-unsolved cold case, Elizabeth becomes the target of a terrifying copycat stalker, forcing her to confront painful memories she has spent a lifetime trying to escape. As she searches for answers alongside her father Reed (David Cubitt) and husband Dan (Hamza Haq), Elizabeth uncovers a tangled web of family betrayal and long-buried secrets.  As she closes in on the truth, Elizabeth must separate fact from manipulation and fight to survive before history repeats itself.

items.title: Absolutely Devoted to You
items.overview: An ambitious TV producer devises a brilliant plan to reunite a 90's boy band for an annual summer beach bash, but her idea is derailed when she falls for the band's reluctant lead singer.

items.title: Where No One Can Find Her
items.overview: When her teen daughter Izzy is kidnapped and buried alive, Jamie and her ex-husband must put aside their differences and work together to raise a massive ransom and save Izzy from a premature grave.

items.title: My Daughter's Trapped in a Throuple
items.overview: When Lori learns her daughter, Mia, has entered a throuple, her concern turns to fear when one member of the relationship is found dead and Mia becomes the prime suspect.

items.title: Murder in the Highland Manor
items.overview: Kate takes a job as a live-in tutor at a secluded Scottish estate for a mother and daughter who’ve escaped domestic abuse. But when she discovers the previous au pair mysteriously disappeared, Kate becomes embroiled in the family’s deadly secrets.

items.title: Terry McMillan Presents: Tempted 2 Love
items.overview: A star chef heads to Ireland for a major culinary event with her new love, only to find her much-younger ex there too. As they work side by side with their current partners, old feelings resurface, challenging their hearts and careers.

items.title: When I Said I Do
items.overview: Ali Corley is a widowed search-and-rescue K-9 handler who rebuilt her life after losing her husband in the line of duty. When she meets seasoned rescue specialist Shawn Willis, their connection forces them both to confront the true meaning of commitment.

items.title: Bee My Love
items.overview: Private chef Hannah Jones, competing for her dream job with a celebrity restaurateur, finds inspiration in her mother’s recipes, the sweetness of honey, and a struggling beekeeper who teaches her to believe that life, and love, are sweetest when shared.

items.title: The Moonlight Murders
items.overview: An investigative reporter gets an exclusive interview with a key witness to the latest in a series of serial killings. Little does she know, her new interview suspect harbors a dangerous obsession.

items.title: Pushed Off a Plane and Survived
items.overview: Jaynie miraculously cheats death after her husband Cole’s betrayal.

items.title: Caught by Love
items.overview: While on a journey of self-discovery, a resort guest gets swept into an undercover investigation for stolen jewels that turns into an unexpected and adventurous romance.

items.title: The Scarecrows' Wedding
items.overview: Devoted scarecrows Betty O'Barley and Harry O'Hay are planning a wedding to remember. When Harry insists on leaving the farm to collect one last thing for their big day, smooth-talking Reginald Rake swoops in with plans of his own. Chaos follows, and soon Betty's in danger and everything's at risk. Can Harry get back in time and save the day?

items.title: All's Fair in Love and Mahjong
items.overview: Ronni is living a full life as a school nurse and mom, hosting a longtime mahjong game with her best friends Shelley, Carly, and Melissa. But when her daughter leaves for college, everything shifts at once. Her hours get cut. Her ex is pushing to sell the home she loves. And suddenly she's staring down an empty nest wondering what comes next.

items.title: Nelly Knows Mysteries: All Manners of Murder
items.overview: Nelly and Detective Michael set out to solve the  murder of a guest while at a lavish dinner.

items.title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
items.overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

items.title: Because of Cupid
items.overview: Best friends Naomi and Marcus participate in a Valentine's Day mocktail competition but things go awry when Cupid interferes with a love potion that affects Marcus and several of their friends.

items.title: True Justice: Eye For An Eye
items.overview: Amateur sleuths tackle a fresh challenge at a local school, diving into the fierce world of parent politics. Their investigation uncovers hidden agendas and unexpected alliances as they navigate the complex web within the community.

items.title: Accused: The Karen Read Story
items.overview: When police officer John O'Keefe is found dead, his girlfriend, Karen Read, is charged in connection with his death. What begins as a shocking tragedy quickly ignites a firestorm that captures national attention as Karen fights to clear her name.

items.title: Picture Perfect Sister-in-Law
items.overview: Three years after escaping a notorious child abductor known as the 'Carousel Kiler', former investigative journalist Parker Bennington has rebuilt her life as a university lecturer near her brother's family. But when disturbing symbols from the past—carousel music boxes—start appearing, and her sister-in-law begins acting strangely, Parker suspects someone is targeting her again.

items.title: Thomas & Friends: Really Helpful Engines
items.overview: When Gordon needs help, Thomas takes on extra work alone to prove himself. But a busy day on Sodor shows that even useful engines need their friends.

items.title: The Guest Who Wouldn't Leave
items.overview: Tom and his daughter Cora decide to open their guest house to short term renters, however when their first renter Elise begins to overstay her welcome, Tom is faced with the reality that he may never be able to get her to leave.

items.title: Death at the Dinner Party
items.overview: When a star psychology student dies during a faculty party, Andrea Gibbs and her son Ethan are drawn into the dangerous manipulations of renowned professor Alan Jackson, a man determined to bury the truth at any cost.

items.title: Snowbound for the Holidays
items.overview: Hotel manager Cassidy Evergreen evaluates a cozy ski lodge, but Christmas magic—and its charming owner, Trey Sanderson—turn a simple assignment into a heartfelt choice between duty and love.

items.title: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter
items.overview: Taylor Tomlinson takes her fans to church with hilarious confessions about dating in her 30s, her dream assistant and why she refuses to use AI.

items.title: Girl in the Coffin
items.overview: After the death of her mother, Jasmine is struggling to move forward when she finds comfort in Bill, the compassionate funeral director. But beneath Bill's kindness lies a dangerous obsession as he believes they are destined to be together.

items.title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
items.overview: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

items.title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Prelude to a Wedding
items.overview: When Gethsemane is invited to play at a wedding, she and Eamon find themselves involved in the death of a member of the bridal party.

items.title: A Whimsy Christmas Carol
items.overview: When the ambitious of a beloved toy company faces a looming corporate takeover, she must rediscover the true meaning of the holiday with the help of the Christmas Spirits  and a charming former flame who has always believed in her  or risk losing everything she’s worked so hard to build.

items.title: Where the Heart Lands
items.overview: A Kentucky horse trainer's world is upended when a handsome LA lawyer inherits her stable. To stop him from selling, she and the locals drag him into the excitement of horse racing, finding love along the way.

items.title: My Daughter Was Taken
items.overview: After witnessing her daughter's abduction during a video call, a former prosecutor races home from Spain, only to become the next target. Hunted by someone who thinks she saw too much, she must risk everything to stay alive... and save the one person she can't live without.

items.title: A House Built on Lies
items.overview: Inspired by true events. When Daisy's husband is murdered, the news brings on a sudden, traumatic labor. Now, reliant on medication following a complicated birth, Daisy depends on her best friend Louise to help care for her son. But her husband’s death has triggered a strange series of events, and she soon finds herself in danger. Will she be able to uncover the truth in time to save herself and her new baby?

items.title: Rescued by Faith: The Connie and Larry Van Oosten Story
items.overview: Connie and Larry Van Oosten are jolted awake by a masked gunman standing at the foot of their bed. Abducted from their home and locked inside a hidden bunker, the couple must endure days of torment.

items.title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Key to the Castle
items.overview: When a ghost hunter show comes to town, it's up to Gethsemane and Eamon to solve the unexpected murder of the host, allowing the brand-new spirit to cross-over.

items.title: Christmas Uncorked
items.overview: A sophisticated sommelier returns to her small hometown for Christmas and must work with the local tavern chef to put on the best holiday feast the town has ever seen.

items.title: Max vs 100
items.overview: Follows Four-time Formula 1 World Champion Max Verstappen who will take on 100 drivers in a unique go-karting event competition.

items.title: Secrets of the Bayeux Tapestry: Inside the Museum
items.overview: The Bayeux Tapestry is one of the treasures of the medieval world. Across 70 metres of exquisitely embroidered scenes, it tells the story of one of the most seismic events in British history – the Norman Invasion of 1066.  For the last 950 years, this crucial part of Britain's national story has remained on the other side of the English Channel, in Bayeux, Normandy, but now it’s coming back to the UK.  A stellar cast of historians and experts follow the painstaking efforts to bring this priceless work of art back to the UK, where experts believe it was made, for a once-in-a-millennium exhibition at the British Museum.

items.title: Garage Sale Mysteries: Murder Takes the Stage
items.overview: One of the members of Jennifer Shannon's true-crime book club is murdered during the group's reenactment of the Lizzie Borden case.

items.title: To Catch a Stepfather
items.overview: After the death of her husband, Allison Simon finds love again with charming businessman Roger, but her son Eric quickly senses something sinister beneath his new stepfather's perfect facade.

items.title: Kidnapped in Her Own Home: The Martha Carelli Story
items.overview: Follows Martha Carelli whose life is shattered when an escaped convict takes her hostage and forces her to drive his getaway car. She must outwit her increasingly volatile captor to survive.

items.title: Meet Me in the Margins
items.overview: A book editor secretly pens her own romance manuscript, only to find unexpected editorial notes from a mysterious critic in the margins. The film is a witty, heartwarming story about finding love between the lines.

items.title: Village Idiot
items.overview: "Village Idiot" is a sharp, heartfelt comedy-drama about a stubborn English grandmother, Barbara, who chains herself to her cottage to resist eviction by High Speed train developers. She then discovers that the company’s liaison sent to remove her is her estranged grandson, Peter. What follows is a clash between generations, class, and values: Barbara’s fierce attachment to home and identity versus Peter’s desperate need to hold onto his corporate job. As their battle becomes public, turning into a small-town spectacle of protest, press, and community chaos, both are forced to confront what “home” really means, and how love, pride, and belonging can both bind and divide a family. Witty, warm, and deeply human, "Village Idiot" captures rural England on the brink of change with equal parts humour and heartbreak.

items.title: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
items.overview: When the fairy tale royal wedding of Olivia Perkins and Prince Alexander is derailed by an archaic law, the couple must confront an uncertain future and fight for their right to be together.

items.title: Love Finds You
items.overview: A mislabeled package convinces jewelry designer Alex she's found her ideal man, sending her and delivery driver Jack on a citywide search that helps them discover what they truly want.

items.title: Sole Survivor of Flight 119
items.overview: After surviving a devastating plane crash deep in the Mexican jungle, sole survivor Lisa Foster must rely on her resourcefulness, inner strength and faith to endure the unforgiving wilderness and find her way home to her young daughter.

items.title: The Christmas Gift Guide
items.overview: When a marketing exec who can suddenly hear Christmas wishes is paired with a momfluencer for a holiday gift guide, he must use his unusual new power to win her over—and the account—only to discover that the greatest gift may be love.

items.title: Death Name
items.overview: A young Korean American woman yearns to learn more about her heritage, not knowing the further she digs, the more she reawakens a deadly family curse.

items.title: An Unstable Marriage
items.overview: A woman investigates clues into her husbands disappearance at the equestrian center they run together.

items.title: The Wrong Baby Daddy
items.overview: Lila’s life finally feels complete when she starts a dream job with her close friend Robin, falls into a promising romance with Mark, and discovers she’s pregnant. But everything shifts when Julia, Mark’s ex-wife, reappears the moment she learns about the baby. At first, Julia’s involvement seems harmless, even polite, until she begins showing up uninvited, inserting herself into every corner of Lila’s new life. As Julia’s presence grows more intrusive and her intentions more unsettling, Lila realizes she may be fighting to protect far more than just her future. Soon, what began as a perfect new chapter becomes a tense battle of boundaries, obsession, and survival.

items.title: Who Could Kill a Sweet Old Lady
items.overview: When Edie becomes the new caregiver to an extremely rich elderly woman, she soon starts to suspect that someone wants her client dead - and that she's now the only thing standing in their way.

items.title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
items.overview: Lindsey and her extended family head to Walt Disney World to spend a magical Christmas together, but the dream of a jolly holiday gets quickly dashed when Lindsey discovers her room is next door to Philip, a disastrous first date she recently had, who’s also there on a family trip. As Lindsey and Philip’s paths cross throughout their stay, the frost starts to thaw as they learn they’re not so different from each other after all. Thanks to some Walt Disney World magic, the holiday wish Lindsey made in Cinderella Fountain just might turn their rivalry into romance.

items.title: The Couple Across the Street
items.overview: When a family seeks refuge with their "doomsday prepper" neighbors during a community lockdown, they start to suspect their hosts have dangerous intentions, until a shocking twist reveals the real threat was far closer than they ever imagined.

items.title: Blessings in Disguise
items.overview: Katie, a driven New York fashion designer with only three weeks to develop a collection that could launch her brand to national prominence. Katie reconnects with Luke, her first love and now a gifted furniture designer and woodworker whose designs are rooted in craftmanship, patience, and purpose. As their lives intertwine once more, the two discover that inspiration is not found in deadlines or demand - but in the timeless values of home, heritage, and hope.

items.title: The Ocean Between Them
items.overview: A family vacation in Belize turns into a nightmare when a sudden storm strands a young kayaker named Miranda at sea, prompting her mother, Joan, to launch a desperate search.

items.title: Murder in Music City
items.overview: When a rising young musician is found murdered at the estate of country music legend Abilene Tucker, all evidence points to the scandal-plagued diva. But as her estranged daughter Caroline digs for the truth, she uncovers a web of obsession.

items.title: The Twin Who Lived
items.overview: After discovering she once had a twin sister who died when she was a child, Claire begins receiving strange gifts signed with her sister's name. What at first seems like a cruel prank soon escalates into disturbing signs that someone is breaking into her home and trying to take control of Claire's life.

items.title: She Stole My Son's Heart
items.overview: After her last heart transplant fails, Maria is in desperate need of a new heart. Fearing it could give out at any moment, she turns down her boyfriend’s proposal and heads out for a walk — only to mysteriously disappear. As the search intensifies, homicide and missing persons detective Vicky and her rookie partner are assigned to the case. With Maria's time running out, it becomes a race to uncover the truth behind Maria's disappearance before her failing heart gives out.

items.title: Barking All the Way
items.overview: Billie is a workaholic realtor who heads home for Christmas but her journey is derailed after a loveable but chaotic canine named Yappy almost causes her car to crash. After talking to Yappy's owner, the mysterious yet oddly familiar Mrs. C, Billie agrees to watch Yappy while she visits her grandchildren for the holidays. Yappy ends up playing the role of matchmaker and new best friend, pulling Billie towards her traveling contractor ex-boyfriend from high school, Hutch. Eager to move on, she's determined to leave Hutch in the past, but when her mother hires him to work on their shed, she finds herself spending more time with him than she ever expected. As the holidays draw closer, Billie begins to question whether chasing her dream of becoming her firm's number one seller is truly what she wants. When the mysterious Mrs. C leaves her cabin for Billie and Hutch to breathe new life into, her answer may come sooner than expected.

items.title: The Christmas Ornament Library
items.overview: The meticulous librarian Alice Montgomery and newspaper reporter Noah Conrad discover a forgotten room hidden beneath their town's historic library, filled with hundreds of Christmas ornaments containing handwritten memories from generations past. As they set out to reunite each treasured keepsake with its rightful family, the pair rekindles a cherished Christmas tradition, strengthen an entire community, and discover that the greatest gifts of the season are the stories – and people – we carry in our hearts.

items.title: Love on the Amazon
items.overview: Claire travels to Brazil and hires Danny, a riverboat captain, to help her deliver an important message for her sister Amelia, a marine biologist studying pink dolphins on the Amazon River.

items.title: The Daughter She Left Behind
items.overview: After years spent working internationally, Rachel returns home desperate to reconnect with the daughter she left behind. But when a terrifying man threatens Samantha's life, Rachel must finally become the mother she never was.

items.title: Aussie at Heart
items.overview: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

items.title: I Have to Kill My Neighbor
items.overview: Lauren’s idyllic suburban life is shattered when her husband, Tom, is kidnapped. His anonymous captors give Lauren a strange ultimatum: she must kill Madeline - the next-door neighbor that Lauren despises.

items.title: Love in Exile
items.overview: Set to a jazz accompaniment, the dramatic performance centered on Black love and survival weaves together Bible verses, free-verse and prose Davis wrote for the program, “The Ghetto.”  In "The Ghetto," a husband and wife have a gripping conversation about the psychological and physical scars left by systemic oppression. They question if love can thrive in the face of a city's poverty, rats, and official indifference, and if staying tough is enough to survive.

items.title: Hitler’s Games: Berlin 1936 in Colour
items.overview: In 1931, Germany was awarded the Olympic Games in the hope this would draw them into the international community and world peace would be promoted through sport.  For two weeks in August 1936 cameras captured the world’s greatest sporting spectacle, including the Gold Medal triumphs of record-breaking sprinter Jesse Owens. The Berlin Olympics were groundbreaking – many innovations introduced in 1936 such as television coverage and the torch relay became part of every subsequent Games.  Hitler’s Games in Colour tells the story of the remarkable amateurs who excelled, but also how Hitler used the Games as propaganda for his brutal regime, to show the Nazis as benign and their military ambitions as modest. Using black and white archive, transformed by cutting-edge restoration and colourisation, this is the story of 16 days that fooled the world…

items.title: Faith & Forgiveness: A Duck Dynasty Love Story
items.overview: Lisa and Al Robertson, known from Duck Dynasty, fell hard and fast believing they had found a once-in-a-lifetime love. But betrayal and unspoken pain slowly fracture what they built together. When the truth comes to light, both must confront everything they thought they knew about love and loyalty — and decide if their marriage and faith are worth fighting for.

items.title: Pete Holmes: Silly Silly Fun Boy
items.overview: Comedian Pete Holmes delivers fresh takes on parenting, marriage and more.

items.title: What She Didn't Tell Me
items.overview: When a disturbing overdose rocks her new town, a determined but grieving pharmacist must unravel the link between a growing teen drug crisis and a mysterious grief website before her own daughter becomes the next target.

items.title: Romance at Hope Ranch
items.overview: Hope Morgan sets out to begin a new chapter of her life—fulfilling her childhood dream of running a ranch in the picturesque town of Ruidoso, New Mexico and reviving the beloved Giddy Up Gala.

items.title: Who Took My Family
items.overview: When devoted wife and mother Courtney’s whole family mysteriously disappears, she embarks on a desperate search, uncovering dark secrets and dangerous threats that force her to test the lengths she’ll go to find them.

items.title: Nowhere Left to Hide
items.overview: A desperate woman starts over again in a small seaside town after faking her own death to escape from her abusive husband. But when he tracks her down, he starts to threaten the lives of those around her until she agrees to be with him forever.

items.title: Murder in the Dark
items.overview: A blind waitress at a dining-in-the-dark restaurant becomes the sole witness to a murder, making her the next target of a killer determined to eliminate the only person who could identify him.

items.title: The Woman Before Me
items.overview: When Jenna learns her husband was once married to a woman who could be her double, she unravels a chilling pattern of obsession, deceit, and murder that makes her question whether she’s his next victim.

items.title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
items.overview: Hyper organized single mom and party planner Lexi, her free-spirited mother June, and teen daughter Piper are set to spend Christmas at a local ski resort after Lexi is hired to organize their annual holiday party. Upon arrival, she immediately butts heads with Ridge, the ski instructor and son of the lodge's owner, Dan.

items.title: Sugar & Vice: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
items.overview: Hannah finds a body at the grand re-opening of the Lake Eden Inn. When a storm traps everyone inside, Hannah must find the culprit before the road clears and the killer escapes.

items.title: Everyone Has Something to Hide
items.overview: Kathy is shocked when she finds out her son Noah's former best friend Ethan has been murdered. She's even more shocked when her straight-A son is the prime suspect. Kathy fights to clear her son's name.

items.title: The Castle
items.overview: "The Castle" follows three siblings left to fend for themselves after their mother suddenly disappears. Connor, Jamie, and Mia try to keep their lives afloat, transforming their suburban house into a makeshift fortress as they wait for her return. Told through the eyes of wildly imaginative middle brother Connor, "The Castle" traces fraying sibling relationships, survival strategies, and the grand stories children tell each other to feel safe. A tender, soulful story about growing up too soon, and rescuing yourself before it’s too late.

items.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
items.overview: When ambitious freelance reporter Avery Clark returns to Chicago to spend Christmas with her mom and new stepdad, she's hoping for a little holiday downtime before her next assignment. Instead, she lands a feel-good story profiling Darlene Donnelly, a beloved Chicago Bears superfan about to celebrate an incredible milestone: attending her 500th game. There's just one catch: Avery knows next to nothing about football or Chicago. Enter Darlene's handsome grandson Matt, a Chicago firefighter and die-hard Bears fan who, with a little gentle nudging from Darlene, agrees to show Avery what being a part of Bears Nation is all about.

items.title: Zoners
items.overview: Brothers, flatmates and polar opposites Samir and Nikhil find themselves on an adventure when they accidentally steal a package from their maniac neighbour Ivan.

items.title: Sinister Secret Ingredient
items.overview: When dentist Mel buys a small-town clinic to start a new life, she meets Ruth, a beloved baker and neighbor with a tragic past. But when Mel’s 12-year-old daughter Abby goes missing, Mel uncovers Ruth’s horrifying secret.

items.title: Silver Bells at Christmas
items.overview: In Comfort, Kentucky, Ginny Nolan tries to keep her family's Christmas shop afloat as coffee-chain owner Nick Day offers to buy it. Meanwhile, Ginny's ex-flame and former songwriting partner Tyler Benton returns to town, seeking her help.

items.title: Christmas Delivered
items.overview: Determined to unwind from the stresses and loneliness of her everyday life, Kimberly Carr travels to Canada to spend Christmas with her grandmother, JoJo, at her beautiful, cozy farmhouse. Kimberly's plans for a restorative holiday are turned upside down when she crosses paths with Ben Chambers, owner of a local tree farm and new Christmas tree delivery app called TreeBen. Ben's a dreamer who never looks before he leaps while Kimberly is methodical and lives her life based on practicality. But when Ben's app is plagued by an onslaught of issues, Kimberly uses her tech expertise to help him out and ensure that no one in town is deprived of a Christmas tree... even though she isn't convinced of the need for the app in such a small town. Kimberly and Ben discover they may have more in common than they realized. In the process, Kimberly begins to question if she's truly happy with her life or if she's ready for a change and ready for romance.

items.title: A Castle of Our Own
items.overview: When an overworked architect takes an unexpected summer trip, a sandcastle contest and a contractor help her reconnect with her daughter, rediscover joy, and find love she never saw coming.

items.title: Inky Pinky Ponky 2
items.overview: Sequel to the 2023 film Inky Pinky Ponky

items.title: The Little Girl Who Didn't Exist
items.overview: When Mel tries to meet the parents of her daughter's new playmate Sara, she finds that everyone claims the child doesn't exist. But as evidence mounts that Sara is real, Mel becomes convinced that someone is hiding the girl to conceal a dark secret.

items.title: The Trouble With Mistletoe
items.overview: An acquisitions executive who returns home for Christmas and unexpectedly reconnects with the former fiancé she left behind. As the traditions of her hometown rekindle old memories, she begins to wonder if the life she walked away from may still be the one meant for her.

items.title: Letters This Christmas
items.overview: A young romance author leaves New York City after her novel is panned, hoping to write a redemption novel from home in Alaska. Finding inspiration in her former lover, and the mysterious Christmas cards left at her keys, newfound success has her making the difficult choice between returning to New York for a career of fictional romance, and her real romance in Alaska.

items.title: Don't Breathe a Word
items.overview: Meredith runs a Lamaze business and hires Eve, who becomes her best friend. When Eve is stalked, Meredith is determined to help. As she investigates, Meredith discovers Eve might be hiding a dark secret.

items.title: Our Dead Husband
items.overview: Graphic design firm owner Kris is devastated when she discovers her husband, Ritchie, shot dead in their home. She assumes it has to do with Ritchie's work in high-level intelligence. But as Kris prepares for the funeral, she learns that Ritchie's stories about his missions were a cover for a secret family a few hours away. When police begin to suspect Kris for the murder and an attempt is made on her life, she must overcome her distrust of Ritchie's other wife to find out who killed him—and who is now trying to kill her.

items.title: Somebody's Watching Me
items.overview: After a friend's bachelorette weekend, Lori receives a flash drive with footage from a hidden camera at their Airbnb. The footage is of her sleeping and then a masked stranger entering the room and watching her.

items.title: A Christmas Prayer Tradition
items.overview: Natalie prepares for the launch of her debut children’s book, Adeline the Angel, while Wes continues to deepen his faith journey. When Caroline quietly begins a mission to answer the prayers and needs of those around her community, the family discovers that some of God’s greatest works are accomplished through simple acts of kindness. As Christmas approaches, Bellford Falls once again becomes a place where hope is restored, prayers are answered, and hearts are drawn closer to the reason for the season.

items.title: The Dating App Nightmare
items.overview: Single mom Kate signs up for a dating app with her daughter Sarah, turning it into a fun bonding moment. But the fun ends fast when Sarah goes missing after a date with someone she met on the app. With little help, Kate launches her own search.

items.title: Deadly Destination Wedding
items.overview: After flying to a secluded island resort ahead of a friend's destination wedding, a recently single lawyer begins a passionate fling with a charming stranger. When her passport disappears, she realizes the man she trusted may have trapped her in paradise.

items.title: The Woman with Three Husbands
items.overview: Concerned her impressionable brother has joined an isolated polyamorous family, Natalie investigates her new 'in-laws'. The strange death of one of Marcus's fellow 'brother husbands' leads Natalie to realize her brother is living with a killer

items.title: Variety’s Power of Women London
items.overview: Variety’s Power of Women held its inaugural U.K. edition on June 3, 2026, at the Chancery Rosewood in London. Presented in partnership with Lifetime, the event celebrated five high-profile honorees who were each featured on individual covers of a special accompanying issue.

items.title: The Boy by the Pool
items.overview: A woman's sun-soaked vacation takes a sinister turn when she meets a picture-perfect couple whose son bears a striking resemblance to a young boy who disappeared two years earlier.

items.title: Thomas & Friends: The Classic Stories
items.overview: Enjoy this compilation film of Thomas & Friends with classic episodes

items.title: Toni Braxton’s Breathe Again
items.overview: Jennifer, Vanessa, and Evelyn meet as contestants on a reality dating show and suffer heartbreak under the spotlight. Their shared rejection sparks an unlikely sisterhood that carries them from Los Angeles to a new life in Seattle.

items.title: A Grand Biltmore Christmas
items.overview: In 1895, Elizabeth meets Michael, a teen trespasser at Biltmore House who vanishes. When he returns 20 years later, a magic hourglass pulls her to the present. She must return home before being found and before love alters her destiny.

items.title: He'll Never Find Me
items.overview: After fleeing an abusive marriage and faking her own death, a woman builds a new life on a farm in a quiet Midwestern town—until a viral video exposes her identity.

items.title: A Sweet Christmas Anniversary
items.overview: In this enchanting third story in the Home Sweet Christmas franchise, Sophie and Sam embark to celebrate their first anniversary in picturesque Salzburg, a sprawling Christmas postcard town adorned with decorations and lights, a place one can almost smell the scents of mulled wine and gingerbread. What begins as a romantic first-year getaway quickly transforms into a lavish royal mystery when a charismatic hotelier draws the couple into a world of festive surprises. As Sophie uncovers a hidden connection to a beloved Christmas song, she and Sam must navigate the host’s surprising twists to safeguard their love – and to rediscover the true spirit of Christmas.

items.title: An Angel in My Stocking
items.overview: Three years after a disastrous marriage, Amanda unexpectedly gets stranded with her ex-husband Jack in a remote Vermont town, where a mysterious traveler claiming to be her guardian angel pushes them to confront their past.

items.title: 2025: The Year from Space
items.overview: In 2025, satellites recorded wildfires sweeping through the hills of Hollywood, shifting battle lines in Ukraine, and nearly 600 million people assembling for a sacred pilgrimage along the River Ganges. From orbit, imagery exposed the vast displacement of civilians in Gaza, while reconnaissance satellites traced covert weapons transfers from North Korea to Russia. Scientists also relied on satellite data to count migrating wildebeest and walrus, monitoring the planet’s health. Combined with news archives, eyewitness accounts, user-generated content, and expert analysis, these views from above reveal the hidden story of 2025.

items.title: LEGO Friends: Heartlake the Musical
items.overview: Young Daisy turns to toy bricks as she finds herself trying to fit into a new school in a new country. When she stumbles across a mysterious key, she is transported to Heartlake City where she makes new friends. But they soon require her help to save a vital local landmark – with plenty of song and dance numbers along the way.

items.title: Secrets on the Ranch
items.overview: After inheriting her late mother’s declining Montana ranch, recently divorced Romy Taylor uncovers the remains of her long missing sister in the backyard while digging a garden.

items.title: Ten Thousand Reasons for Revenge
items.overview: After a struggling single mom's daughter takes money from a dying bank robber, the two become entangled in a tense investigation that threatens everything they love.

items.title: The Monster She Married
items.overview: Groomed since she was a teen, a woman confronts the dark truth about her husband, the man she once trusted as her pediatrician. When another one of his patients is murdered just days before testifying against him, she must break her silence.

items.title: Friends Until the End
items.overview: When a luxurious weekend brunch turns deadly after their host is found mysteriously murdered, a group of longtime friends must unravel buried secrets and survive a series of chilling attacks.

items.title: Proper Ladies
items.overview: Four very different schoolgirls are thrown together in detention. As they plan their escape, the situation spirals out of control.

items.title: Mama's Little Murderer
items.overview: A devoted single mother, Constance, struggles to balance her newfound love with Leo and the obsessive, destructive behavior of her son, Anthony, who will go to extreme lengths to keep her to himself.

items.title: Who Killed My Husband's Mistress?
items.overview: Megan's attempt to break free from her troubled marriage takes a deadly turn when she witnesses her husband's murder just days after his mistress was killed. As ominous threats start to close in, she soon realizes she could be the next target.

items.title: Let's Murder Like It's 1999!
items.overview: Laney is dreading her high school reunion because of a sad background. However, when classmates begin to die, she must find the perpetrator before she or her daughter become the next victim.

items.title: A Murder Between Friends
items.overview: A legendary TV star solves a murder mystery at her country estate.

items.title: Her Husband's Double Life
items.overview: Carrie's world is shattered when her husband is found critically injured in a car crash with another woman by his side--a woman who also claims to be his wife. Carrie discovers that someone will stop at nothing to erase her from the picture.

items.title: Don't Trust the Quiet Ones
items.overview: A divorced mom finds her daughter’s favorite influencer murdered after a mall event. Reporting suspicious behavior puts her family in danger, prompting her ex to take them to a snowy cabin. But the threat may be closer than she thinks.

items.title: Wild
items.overview: Wild is a survival dramedy set in the breath-taking yet unforgiving Scottish Highlands. Lou, Dev, and Alistair, three old friends clinging to their annual wild camping tradition, begin with banter, nostalgia, and amateur vlogging, but soon unravel into a battle of egos, secrets, and survival when they get lost, food runs short, and friendships fracture. At once funny, poignant, and unsettling, "Wild" explores the line between adventure and recklessness, and how toxic masculinity has become a huge part of the epidemic decline in men’s mental health.

items.title: Kidnapping My Own Daughter
items.overview: A devoted CPS worker and her family are taken hostage by two desperate parents searching for their wrongfully removed child, exposing a cover-up that threatens her career--and life.

items.title: Don't Trust the Girls Upstairs
items.overview: In the wake of her estranged sister's death, Ashley finds herself caring for her niece, who she's never met before. As they grapple with their shared loss, Ashley must uncover the truth that lurks beneath her own roof, before it's too late

items.title: Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case For the Watchmaker
items.overview: Ainsley McGregor thought craft markets and book clubs, not corpses, would define her new life back home in Sweet River. That is until a beloved member of the book club raises a cold case involving her late husband who was found murdered over his rare antique watch. Ainsley springs into action to untangle a web of small town secrets before the killer winds the clock down on the next victim.

items.title: Surviving the Silence: The Roxane Gay Story
items.overview: When 12-year-old Roxane moves with her family to what appears to be the ideal suburban community, her life is forever changed after a devastating act of sexual violence. As she grapples with the lasting effects of that trauma, Roxane turns to food as a means of survival, beginning a lifelong journey to understand her body, reclaim her voice and confront a society that often defines women by their appearance.

items.title: Crowning at the Prom
items.overview: On the brink of prom queen glory and a coveted athletic scholarship, obsessive overachiever Kat Walker is determined to maintain the flawless image she's built for herself and for her devoted single mother, Abigail.

items.title: I Am Mary Jo Buttafuoco
items.overview: For the first time ever, Mary Jo Buttafuoco tells her story in her own words. In May 1992, outside her Long Island home, Mary Jo was shot in the head by 17-year-old Amy Fisher — the mistress of her husband, Joey Buttafuoco.

items.title: Who's Coming for Christmas?
items.overview: Having recently relocated, Julie is setting up her new home using pieces she inherited from her late grandmother, including a beautiful dining room table she plans to use on Christmas Eve when she hosts dinner for the first time. Though she doesn't have her guest list set just yet Julie takes inspiration from her grandmother and has faith that her holiday table for eight will be filled. Julie's warm, friendly nature leads her to quickly become part of the community and make friends, including her neighbor Mark and his young daughter Vanessa. Mark suggests that he and his family could join her, making Julie's dream of dinner for eight come true. But when bad weather keeps them from making the trip it looks like it will be a silent night with just the three of them unless a small Christmas miracle – or series of miracles – fills her holiday table.

items.title: Forgotten Holiday
items.overview: Kathryn Liu is an antiques buyer for her father’s store and has been happily dating Rob Ashford for nearly a year. When he surprises her with a pre-Christmas proposal, her fear of a failed relationship sends her dashing away without giving him an answer. Heartbroken, as Rob drives to his sister’s house he has a car accident that leaves him without memories of the past year, including their relationship and his once-infectious love of Christmas. Following the unconventional orders from his doctor, Kathryn agrees to help trigger Rob’s memory by retracing their romance and reintroducing him to the holidays. But as his memories inch closer to returning, Kathryn must face the painful truth that bringing Rob back to himself may mean losing him forever, unless she can finally find the courage to fight for the love she was too afraid to claim.

items.title: Noelle Nomads
items.overview: Before they can embark on their luxurious Hawaiian holiday, uptight sports medicine physician Joseph and his daughter Annie must first begrudgingly make a pit stop at a remote campground and deliver a package from his late father to a mysterious person named Birdie. Their plans are derailed when Joseph accidentally crashes into free-spirited Nora's RV at a rest stop. Things go from bad to worse when they not only fail to find the elusive Birdie, but their ancient Winnebago breaks down as well. Forced to spend the next few days at the campground while they wait for replacement parts, Nora introduces Joseph and Annie to the eccentric campers who lovingly dub themselves the Nomads. The embers of romance begin to glow as Nora shows Joseph how to embrace the freedom of camp life. When the mystery of who Birdie is becomes clearer and the much-awaited parts arrive, allowing Joseph and Annie to finally make their Hawaiian getaway,

items.title: Rivals: Messi v Ronaldo
items.overview: As football entered a new era of global prominence, two players emerged who would redefine not just greatness but the sport itself. This film looks at two individuals who didn’t just dominate their era – they created one. For over a decade, their rivalry transcended clubs, countries and competitions, becoming the defining story of modern football – reshaping how the game was played, consumed and debated across the world.

items.title: Celebrity Crime Scene: Princess Diana
items.overview: Follows investigators examining theories surrounding Princess Diana's death, including mysterious vehicles in the tunnel and allegations of powerful forces determined to silence her.

items.title: Center Stage for Murder
items.overview: After suffering a tragic accident, a ballerina finds safety, comfort and intimacy in the arms of her physical therapist. However, she soon becomes a prisoner in her own home when she discovers he's the one responsible for her injury.

items.title: Merry Christmas, Ms. Christmas
items.overview: After losing her job because she got a little too carried away with the Christmas spirit, holiday enthusiast Melanie Patterson sets out to revive her career by organizing her legendary Christmas party, a showcase for her new event planning business. When a charming single father and newcomer to her street steals the show... Read all

items.title: Single Black Tenant
items.overview: After landing an affordable apartment in a quiet neighborhood, Esme's initial relief turns to sheer terror as she begins to suspect her new home is shared by a killer set on framing her for murder.

items.title: A Very Evergreen Christmas
items.overview: Abby inherits her aunt's tree farm under the condition she spends two weeks working there. With the help from Ethan, the farm's longtime caretaker and Abby's best childhood friend, Abby learns that the farm is much more than just a place.

items.title: Closing Time
items.overview: "Closing Time"  sees Mo, a gifted but undocumented migrant working in his uncle’s kebab shop, keep his culinary ambitions hidden until he meets Laila, a thoughtful lawyer trapped in a stagnant engagement. Their connection grows over late-night conversations and cooking sessions, where Laila encourages Mo to pursue his dreams and he gently challenges her to confront the life she’s settled for.

items.title: From Vienna: The New Year’s Celebration 2026
items.overview: The famed Vienna Philharmonic rings in the New Year with its annual concert from Vienna's Musikverein conducted for the first time by Yannick Nézet-Séguin with performances by the Vienna State Ballet and location segments hosted by Hugh Bonneville.

items.title: Behind Closed Doors
items.overview: A murder suspect on the run forces his way into Morgan's home and holds her family captive. She does everything she can to keep them safe, but it seems his arrival at her door may not have been so random after all.

items.title: Arctic Adventure: Ultimate Survival
items.overview: In the Arctic Circle, Jason Fox and an elite team of military veterans open up to each other about men’s mental health while taking on one of the world’s toughest ultramarathons.

items.title: The Secrets of the Matriarch
items.overview: Danielle travels to New Orleans to meet her grandmother and uncover the truth about her mother's death. Drawn into a dangerous feud with the rival Benoit family, Danielle learns her mother’s death was no accident and must navigate treachery, uncover secrets, and decide whether to destroy both families' legacies to find justice.

items.title: Don't Trust the Couple Upstairs
items.overview: Newlyweds Maria and Joe rent out part of their house to Vicki and Clay, a friendly but enigmatic couple. Living together starts well, but when Vicki is killed, Maria uncovers secrets that make her realize Joe isn't the man she married.

items.title: The Death of Klinghoffer
items.overview: An opera in a prologue and two acts by John Adams, with a libretto by Alice Goodman, inspired by the 1985 hijacking of the cruise ship Achille Lauro. Conducted by Lawrence Renes, directed and designed by Luca Guadagnino. A new production by the Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino.
companies: Direzione Produzione TV della Rai CPTV di Napoli

items.title: A CNN & Variety Town Hall Event: Timothée Chalamet and Matthew McConaughey
items.overview: Filmed before a live audience of students at The University of Texas at Austin's Moody College of Communication, this event brings together two of Hollywood's most dynamic actors, Timothée Chalamet and Matthew McConaughey, for a candid discussion about their craft and creative process. In addition to reflecting on their approaches to performance and the roles that have most influenced their artistic journeys, Chalamet and McConaughey will also take questions from the student audience throughout the program.

items.title: The Greek Aisle
items.overview: When Georgia travels to the Greek island of Corfu to finalize an inheritance, she unexpectedly discovers that marrying her handsome co-inheritor is the only way to meet the requirements.

items.title: An Ozark Mountain Christmas
items.overview: When a dedicated young designer at a crossroads reluctantly follows her sister home to the nostalgic heart of the Ozarks for Christmas, she finds herself rediscovering not only her family’s legacy for commitment to craft, but also the quiet faith and purpose she has lost in the rush of modern life. With the help of Paul, Clara will reconnect with work rooted in care and community.

items.title: Murder at the Merriweather
items.overview: When her best friend falls to her death at the luxury resort where they both work, Sophie fights to learn the truth of what happened. But in this world of haves and have-nots, everyone hides a secret.

items.title: A Proud Family Wizmas
items.overview: A song-filled, stop-motion holiday special

items.title: Mr. & Mrs. Christmas
items.overview: Taylor Lewis, a single father and expert in holiday displays, moves to the picturesque town of Pineway with his two children just weeks before Christmas. While the family adjusts to a new home and school, Taylor also faces the realization that his teenage daughter may be growing out of some of their treasured Christmas traditions.  When Taylor becomes involved in reviving Pineway's Christmas Market, he's paired with Sophie Shaw, a practical accountant eager to prove herself as a potential leader. Their different approaches soon complement each other, bringing new life and festive spirit to the town.  As Taylor tries to hold onto the Christmas traditions his family once shared, he discovers that meaningful moments can't simply be recreated. Growing closer to Sophie along the way, he begins to see that embracing change can lead to new traditions, new memories, and perhaps an unexpected new beginning.

items.title: Home Makeover Nightmare
items.overview: After the sudden passing of her mother, Dayna returns to Los Angeles to sell the family home. She teams up with her old friend, Mike, now a successful real estate agent. As sparks ignite, Mike's obsession with her grows, manipulating every aspect of her life until the home makeover he proposes becomes a nightmare.

items.title: Yaxlont
items.overview: When a teenage boy has a girl over for the first time, the overly attached monster under his bed has a meltdown.

items.title: The Night She Disappeared
items.overview: After her teenage daughter vanishes after sneaking out of the house, a single mother becomes obsessed with a local urban legend about teens disappearing after a dangerous initiation event.

items.title: Thou Shall Not Commit Adultery
items.overview: When Cassie, a Christian feminist icon and bestselling author, is blackmailed with videos of her affair, she must fight to protect her brand and marriage. But as her trusted assistant's betrayal escalates, Cassie faces a terrifying choice.

items.title: You See L.A.
items.overview: Delves into personal narratives, emotional stakes, and tight-knit community of UCLA's Women's Basketball team during a pivotal season in the program's history.

items.title: The Doghouse
items.overview: Brothers Steve and Stu scramble to put on a last-minute birthday show for Steve’s daughter - because if they fail, Steve’s in the doghouse and Stu might end up… dead.

items.title: Adopting St. Nick
items.overview: Maren is a busy single mother to her adopted daughter, Leah. As the owner of her late father’s beloved hardware store, Maren is often found helping repair just about anything for her fellow locals, leaving very little time for herself. When the opportunity to participate in the Christmas Companions program at Jolly Acres, a new yet thriving retirement community in town, Leah excitedly jumps at the chance as she misses having a grandfather in her life. Much to Leah’s delight, she is paired with Kris, a jolly resident who bears an uncanny resemblance to Santa Claus. While there, Maren crosses paths with the nomadic Reid, the center’s Director of Community Launch and Operations, whose job has him traveling from facility to facility to launch new branches.

items.title: Trapped in the Spotlight
items.overview: Neveah, a canceled R&B singer, struggles to rebuild her career and regain her fame 15 years after breaking up with her estranged co-star, Lupita, who publicly betrayed her.

items.title: The Christmas Treehouse
items.overview: When Emma returns to her hometown for Christmas after years away, she reconnects with Ryan, who never left. Drawn together by holiday traditions and a treasured childhood treehouse, old feelings resurface, revealing that love may be closer than she imagined.

items.title: Christmas Wrapped in Love
items.overview: Natasha Lloyd has built a unique business helping clients locate thoughtful, one-of-a-kind gifts for the people they love. When overworked surgeon Ryan Bartlett finds himself tasked with purchasing meaningful Christmas gifts for his entire family, he hires Natasha for help. To uncover the perfect presents, Natasha agrees to pose as Ryan’s girlfriend and spend the holiday season getting to know his family. What begins as a professional arrangement soon becomes something much more as Natasha discovers the true meaning of family, belonging, and love at Christmas.

items.title: a news about “someone who is going to be shot in the head on the street”
items.overview: An old analog news broadcast archive containing a threatening message: “I’ll shoot you in the head on the street”

items.title: Winter Wonderlanes
items.overview: Audrey Bell  is a globe-trotting pop-up restaurateur who returns home for Thanksgiving to the news that her late grandfather’s beloved bowling alley, Wonderlanes, will be sold. Audrey agrees to stay for one last festive season at Wonderlanes and decides to revive its iconic Winter Wonderlanes youth bowling tournament. To drum up publicity for the event, she reluctantly teams up with Jason Miller, a local news reporter and her high school boyfriend. Working side by side the embers of their past start flickering, rekindling feelings they thought they left behind. As the tournament draws near, Audrey questions her next move that will take her away from the people and places she loves…and decide if she’s ready to walk away from Wonderlanes – or finally put down roots where her heart truly belongs.

items.title: Her Only Way Out
items.overview: After surviving a terrifying crash and being coerced into silence, a woman realizes the only way to escape is to stage her own death and disappear completely.

items.title: Whispers Next Door
items.overview: Suzanne hides her daughter’s shocking secret to protect their family, but when their charismatic Pastor takes a disturbing interest in the baby, their lies ignite a chilling battle between faith, control, and truth.

items.title: The Jealous Bride
items.overview: As Meg prepares for her wedding, the return of a woman from her fiancé's past ignites a wave of jealousy she can't contain. Consumed by doubt, she soon spirals into a dangerous obsession that threatens to destroy her love, her faith and her future.

items.title: Snow Globe Town
items.overview: Emily Church joins her sister Zoe and Zoe’s longtime boyfriend on a Christmas getaway to Pine Grove, a town famous for its romantic holiday traditions. While helping with Zoe’s proposal plans, Emily is paired with skeptical journalist Bert Baxter. As they are drawn into the town’s festive celebrations, unexpected feelings begin to challenge what they both thought they knew about love, family and Christmas.

items.title: Christmas in Blue Dog Valley
items.overview: On-set veterinarian Goldie MacKenzie (Cahill) leaves the glamour of Hollywood behind to buy a family-run veterinary clinic in tight-knit Blue Dog Valley, arriving just in time for the town's cherished Christmas season. When Dr. Gable, the clinic's longtime owner, unexpectedly ends up out of town, Goldie is hosted by his handsome son Cohen (Walker), the black sheep of the family because he decided to forego their expectation of becoming a vet. Cohen and Goldie get off on the wrong foot, but when the folks of Blue Dog Valley cold shoulder "the newcomer," Cohen teams up with Goldie to win over even the frostiest of community members. Goldie is also aided by the mysterious canine she dubs Blue whose spontaneous appearances always seem to guide Goldie to exactly where she needs to be. As Goldie works hard to prove herself to the townspeople when furry and Christmas crises arise, she finds herself pulled towards the very heart of her new-found home... and a certain black sheep.

items.title: Wowsabout!
items.overview: Roxy, a free-spirited hedgehog, is on a quest to find the legendary 'magical giants' of Sequoia National Park. Ronald, a meticulous and rule-following piglet, is determined to achieve his carefully planned goal of becoming a junior ranger. At first glance, they couldn’t be more opposite but the awe and wonder of the natural and cultural world shows them that they have more in common than anyone thought. Together they find themselves on a 'Wowsabout' full of music, art, and hysterical adventures!

items.title: The Past Is Never Buried
items.overview: Emily, desperate to find answers about her mother's murder 22 years prior, returns to her hometown when her father, also a suspect in her mother's death, is arrested for the homicide of a local teenager.

items.title: Deadly Sign-In
items.overview: When recorded audio from a murder starts playing on the speakers from an unknown device, Kate doesn’t know if it’s real or a prank.

items.title: Return to Santa
items.overview: Decades after a childhood letter to Santa goes unanswered, Jake has grown into a practical adult who no longer believes in Christmas magic. When Santa finally discovers the lost letter and begins granting Jake’s long-forgotten wishes, his orderly life is thrown into chaos. With his childhood best friend Julie unexpectedly back in town, the two work together to manage each new wish while growing closer along the way.

items.title: The Quiet Hour
items.overview: "The Quiet Hour" is a gripping, intimate drama set over the course of one relentless night shift in an NHS hospital, where overworked nurse Riya battles exhaustion, guilt, and the ghosts of past mistakes while caring for her patients. As she juggles a collapsing system, an understaffed ward, and a stream of emergencies—from dying patients to Fred, a combative amputee, and a medical error that nearly costs a life—her professional composure begins to fracture. Haunted by the memory of a young girl she couldn’t save and the growing distance from her teenage daughter, Riya’s night spirals into a raw reckoning with compassion, burnout, and the quiet heroism that holds the health service together.

items.title: A Christmas Rescue
items.overview: Set in the charming town of Cedar Ridge, A Christmas Rescue follows dedicated physician Emma Ross who along with her dog, Shep, is determined to make her beloved community’s annual Christmas Cares celebration the most meaningful yet. When traveling veterinarian, Dr. Matthew McGuire arrives to temporarily take over the local animal clinic, he proposes adding a Christmas pet adoption event to the festivities. As they work side by side to bring people – and rescue animals – together for the holidays, Emma and Matthew discover that the greatest Christmas miracle may be finding a place where both hearts and shelter pets finally belong.

items.title: Whispers of the North
items.overview: A resilient young woman navigates the silent solitude of her world and confronts the turbulent echoes of family addiction and buried secrets, all while forging a path toward redemption.

items.title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
items.overview: Amber Haque reveals how OnlyFans models suffer widespread exploitation and coercion at the hands of their managers.

items.title: The Nine O'Clock Trot
items.overview: Annie (Kalli Tant) is a recent graduate who has spent six months caring full-time for her grandfather. When he dies, she is broke, unemployed, and unable to afford a funeral. Refusing an unbearable council public health funeral, she keeps his death a secret and turns to the local parish priest, becoming entangled with Father Adam (Johnny Vegas).

items.title: WUFT at CES 2026: Megabytes and Vegas Nights
items.overview: Join WUFT technology reporter Jacob Sedesse on a whirlwind trip as the world's biggest electronics showcase descends upon the Las Vegas Strip.

items.title: Wrestling with Trump
items.overview: Satirist Munya Chawawa immerses himself in US wrestling and MAGA politics, uncovering the links between Donald Trump and the world of body slams, spandex and the power of kayfabe.

items.title: Mistletoe and Mimosas
items.overview: Claire Bennett is a successful business consultant in Manhattan who unexpectedly inherits her beloved Uncle Lou's Christmas-themed bar, The Tipsy Reindeer, in upstate New York. When she returns, Claire discovers the bar comes with high debt – her Uncle Lou was overly generous to people in town while the booming business of Algorithm, an upscale and trendy new club, added insult to injury. She intends to turn things around before Christmas and sell to someone who will preserve her uncle's legacy and then return to her life in the city. Claire meets Zach, Algorithm's part owner and manager, who tells her they want to buy The Tipsy Reindeer so they can expand. Claire bristles at the proposition and they agree to face off in a 12 Days of Christmas-inspired series of festive events to see who can bring in the most business. If Claire wins, Zach will use his contacts to find the right buyer, but if Zach emerges victorious, Claire agrees to consider Algorithm's offer.

items.title: A Danish Christmas
items.overview: Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge and the two find a connection as well.

items.title: The Greatest Christmas Gift
items.overview: When an unexpected setback threatens their Christmas wedding, Emma and Caleb discover that the greatest gifts are found in faith, selfless love and a community that reminds them to keep believing.

items.title: The Discourse
items.overview: Character one finds something and character two can't find out otherwise there will be serious ramifications

items.title: The Christmas Yes List
items.overview: Chloe Hollis, an ambitious New York professional whose habit of putting everyone else first has left her overlooked for the promotion she desperately wants, returns home to Maple Hills, West Virginia, for Christmas. Determined to change her people-pleasing ways, Chloe embarks on an unconventional holiday challenge to overcome her fear of rejection. But when she meets James Stone, a successful executive spending Christmas with family in town, Chloe discovers some of life’s greatest gifts arrive when we stop fearing the answer and start embracing the journey.

items.title: Shiawase wa Tabete Nete Mate: Soshun no Yojo Hen
items.original: しあわせは食べて寝て待て～早春の養生編～
items.overview: Mugimaki Satoko, who has developed an illness she will have to live with for the rest of her life, commutes from an apartment complex where the rent is 50,000 yen to her part-time job four days a week. Having given up on moving to the countryside, she has been feeling somewhat depressed.  One winter day, Tsukasa, who is staying next door, invites her to go for an early-morning walk, but she turns him down. Satoko, who feels self-conscious because everything requires physical strength, is hesitant and says, "Someone like me..." even as her landlady, Suzu, and neighbor Koma get excited talking about romance. Suzu then invites Satoko to her home.  Amid her usual daily life with her coworkers and friends from the apartment complex, surrounded by medicinal cuisine, Satoko gradually finds small moments of happiness. This is a special episode about those ordinary yet quietly wonderful days.

items.title: Sins of an Amish Husband
items.overview: A devout Amish woman suspects foul play after her sister dies in a mysterious barn fire. Driven to protect her nephew, she starts to investigate her brother-in-law, despite the constraints of her close-knit community and its conservative traditions.

items.title: Making Christmas Bright
